<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. Solve one underlying problem per PR.
Use a plain imperative title, such as "Cap keyword-only scores below enriched ones".
No sign-off or generated-by trailers.
-->

## Problem

<!-- One or two sentences. Expected behaviour, and repro steps or the request that shows it. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes it. If it touches several files or layers, say why the same fix needs them. -->

## Scope and approval

<!-- Link the triaged issue, or the Ideas discussion with the maintainer comment approving direction and scope.
For a small, obvious fix, say why it qualifies without one. -->

## Verification

<!-- What you ran and what you saw. For scoring or ranking changes: query, item, numbers before and after.
For UI changes: before/after screenshots, or a short recording when motion matters. State what you could not check. -->
